actionAdapters.when: 仅通过 nova-project-manage-upm-package 为一个精确的已配置 registry SDK/Kit 计划、确认并验证 install-latest 或 upgrade-latest 时

actionAdapters.entry: Packages/manifest.json + Packages/packages-lock.json + resolved SDK/Kit package/package.json + <resolved package>/Nova/{Doc,Docs,DOCS}/INDEX.md
actionAdapters.when: Resolve 稳定后确认精确包 id、版本、来源及其首个存在的包内文档入口；不能用主框架文档替代目标包文档
只对目标包文档定义的 SDK/Kit Config 类型和已确认 Platform Channel DevelopMode 坐标执行受控配置、导出与验证，不接受任意字段 JSON patch

actionAdapters.entry: target package INDEX-documented existing platform prerequisite or configuration entry
actionAdapters.when: 目标包文档明确列出入口、精确项目写入集和目标平台，且用户已单独确认该平台前置变更时

actionAdapters.entry: Play Mode state inspection and target package INDEX-documented local initialization probe
actionAdapters.when: 配置和编译完成、用户允许使用现有项目入口，且探针不要求安装应用、厂商后台写入或声称真机成功时

allow: Packages/manifest.json and Packages/packages-lock.json changes produced only by the confirmed nova-project-manage-upm-package plan and Unity Package Manager Resolve
confirmed ConfigMasterSO, explicit EnabledSDKs or EnabledKits members, ConfigRuntimeSO target and resolved YooAssetSettings.asset changes delegated to nova-project-configure-runtime
target package INDEX-documented project-local platform prerequisite or configuration target only after its exact write set has separate user confirmation
deny: Packages/com.solotopia.nova.framework/**, resolved SDK/Kit package contents or Library/PackageCache/** manual edits
arbitrary JSON, YAML, reflection or execute_code field patches
unconfirmed ConfigMaster coordinate, Config type, platform prerequisite, native project file, Sample, Scene, Prefab or business source
vendor dashboard, credential, store, CDN, external deployment, application install or device state changes
Bundle or Player build, Git commit or push

requiredFor: the exact nova-project-manage-upm-package plan for install-latest or upgrade-latest
ambiguous package identity, source, package documentation entry, ConfigMaster, coordinate, Config type, field change, runtime target, platform prerequisite or local probe
any documented platform prerequisite that writes project configuration or native platform files
create or change SDK/Kit configuration, ConfigRuntimeSO, project platform settings or generated output
credential use, vendor dashboard operation, external write, application install, delete, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: Workflow 权限等于子 Operation 与目标包文档化平台入口的精确权限并集；每次确认只绑定唯一包、版本/来源、包内文档、三维坐标、Config 类型、写入集、平台前置和本地探针。包 Resolve、文档、坐标、字段、平台或写入集漂移后旧确认失效，且密钥值永不进入确认或报告。

evidence: UPM Plan、用户确认、Resolve 后的精确 package id、版本与来源
目标已解析包的首个存在 Nova/Doc、Nova/Docs 或 Nova/DOCS INDEX，以及仅由该 INDEX 指向的配置和平台前置证据
单一 Platform Channel DevelopMode 的 ConfigMaster、目标 Config 类型、ConfigRuntimeSO 导出与 Unity 编译证据
目标包文档定义的最小本地初始化、注册、可用性或错误信号
已脱敏的平台前置结论、未验证外部条件，以及未声称厂商后台或真实设备成功的边界说明
